chapter_title: [Concer]ning why, if the Person shall look down in
spiritual_reading:
# Spiritual Translation

**¶1:** Instruct me concerning this teaching: When the understanding stands above natural truth and looks down into it, if one perceives one's own interior quality reflected there, why does one find that what is highest in wisdom appears turned lowest, and what is lowest in natural life appears uppermost? The order of the spiritual is seen inverted in the mirror of natural truth. Yet when one fixes one's gaze entirely within natural truth, one's true interior quality is not discernible at all, nor can one perceive it there — for natural truth alone, stared into without elevation, cannot reveal the spiritual man to himself.

**¶3:** [GAP-1] This further: The interior quality of the understanding, and the forms of perception, appear inverted in natural truth, and this is what is signified in [GAP-2] the hidden reality of the Divine Call — when it was sent down into the realms of falsity and evil toward the primordial celestial humanity. Sin[GAP-3]ce it descended in this manner, it cast itself downward [GAP-4] like one [GAP-5] who plunges headlong into natural truth — the inmost wisdom entering first into what is outermost and lowest. So it was with the Divine Call: it cast itself with power and urgency into the states below, the highest entering the lowest in inverted order.

**¶4:** And this as well: When one lifts one's understanding upward out of natural truth, one's interior quality ceases to be visible there, being now directed below the field of reflection. This corresponds to the hidden reality of the Reciprocal Acknowledgment that ascended from below — from the primordial celestial humanity, who was its origin, upward to the Divine Living Proceeding. For when the interior turns upward toward its source, it no longer appears within the plane of natural truth beneath it.

**¶5:** The interior qualities of understanding, of affection, and of perception are all visible within natural truth, yet hanging in inverted order. This discloses the hidden reality of the spiritual cognitions and the arrangements of heavenly order, which themselves hang inverted and are visible in the vast gathering of natural knowledges. For the interior nature of human understanding, the quality of every affection, and all forms of perception are rooted in, and begotten from, those spiritual cognitions and their heavenly arrangement. Just as those originating principles, which are spread out in the spiritual world above, stand in inverted relation to the natural — so it is that the hidden reality of one's spiritual origins is disclosed whenever one looks down into natural truth. This is why one finds all reflected forms inverted: the natural is the spiritual seen in opposite arrangement.

**¶6:** Not only this, but [GAP-6] the new life that is born within a person — as the state of its emergence draws near, it hangs in inverted order and enters the natural world highest-first: what is inmost in wisdom and innocence descends first into outward existence. And because of this, the hidden reality of regeneration is revealed in those natural truths into which one gazes.

**¶7:** Behold, the outermost natural appearance of a person who progresses through life is joined to the external plane at every moment. If the person is troubled [GAP-7] his outermost appearance upon the natural plane [GAP-8] above. It is impossible for him to [GAP-9] upon the external plane. See, this hidden reality is [GAP-10] a profound sign, signifying that the entire embodied life originated from the natural plane and had ascended out of the lowest states of existence. And because of this, its outermost correspondence remains joined to the natural, turned downward toward its origin, yet suspended from what is spiritual above — for the shadow of every natural form confesses, by its perpetual attachment to the earth, that the body belongs to that plane, even while the life that animates it descends from what is higher.

reconstructions.reconstructed_text: instruct me about this lesson: When the person is above water and looking down [into the wat]ers, if he shall see his face reflected why shall you find his head turned upside down and also his feet upwards? Yet, when he stares down into the waters, his face shall not be visible, nor can he see it there?

[And] this: The face of people and the shape of trees shall appear turned upside down in the water as this is signified in [the] mystery of the Summons, when it was sent down to the worlds of darkness towards the First Man. Sin[ce it descended] in this way it cast itself down [to the deep] like a person [who] plunges headlong into water; so it is also with the Summons. It cast itself headlong to the worlds below, with strength and diligence.

And this too: Shall the person lift his head up from the water, his face shall not be visible to him, being bent below. This characterises the mystery of the Obedience that ascended from below, from with the First Man his father to the Living Spirit.

The face of people and of animals and of trees is visible in the water, hanging upside down. This occurs to the mystery of the stars and the zodiac, which hang upside down and are visible in the great sea. For the face of people and beasts and all trees hang on the root of the stars and the zodiac, being begotten from them. Just as their fathers, who are spread out above, hang upside down; so it is also that the mystery of their fathers is being revealed to them whenever they stare down into the water. This is, that you shall find their shapes inverted.

Not only this, but [the] child who is born; as the ho[ur] approaches for him to be born, he hangs upside down and is born head first. Indeed, due to this, his mystery shall be revealed in these waters people stare down into.

Behold, you will find the shadow of the person who walks along is joined to the earth all the time. If the person is troubled [he shall find] his shadow up upon the earth [hanging from] above. It is impossible for him to do [... ...] on the earth. See, this mystery is [a] great sign, signifying that the entire body came from the earth and had ascended from the abyss. Again, due to this, its shadow is joined on the earth, turned downwards, and hanging from above.

fills.explanation: Standard Kephalaia paragraph-linking conjunction; the spiritual reading confirms a simple transitional connector introducing the next teaching point.
The definite article is required before "mystery of the Summons," a well-known Manichaean doctrinal formula; the spiritual reading confirms "the hidden reality of the Divine Call."

Completes "Sin-" to "Since" and provides the subject and verb; the spiritual reading explicitly states "Since it descended in this manner," with "in this way" already present in the surviving text after the gap.

The Summons descends into the lowest states (worlds of darkness); "the deep" is standard Manichaean cosmological vocabulary for the abyss below, paralleling "the abyss" mentioned in ¶7 and fitting the correspondential logic of the highest entering the lowest.
Standard relative pronoun connecting "a person" to the verb "plunges headlong"; the spiritual reading confirms "like one who plunges headlong."
The definite article before "child who is born" is grammatically required and the spiritual reading confirms "the new life that is born."

The phrase "he shall find" connects the condition ("if the person is troubled") to the observation of the shadow; it parallels ¶5's "you shall find their shapes inverted" and fits the spiritual sense of perceiving one's outermost appearance upon the natural plane.

Directly parallels the chapter's concluding phrase "hanging from above," describing the shadow as suspended from the person above while joined to the earth below — the outermost natural correspondence attached to the external plane.
The indefinite article before "great sign" is the standard construction; the spiritual reading confirms "a profound sign."
